evidence.description: The initializer receives accountsProvider explicitly but obtains authentication state directly from EcosiaAuthenticationService.shared.
The provider directly uses the global NotificationCenter.default service to register an observer.
Visit registration retrieves the access token directly from EcosiaAuthenticationService.shared rather than an injected authentication dependency.

candidates.explanation: The provider directly accesses operational authentication and notification services through global singleton accessors. These dependencies are not supplied through an explicit replaceable boundary.
candidates.title: Direct Singleton Service Access

evidence.description: The class exposes mutable published authentication and profile properties without actor isolation.
A public static shared instance makes the mutable instance state globally reachable.
Profile updates mutate the shared instance's properties on MainActor, but this method-level isolation does not isolate the property declarations or their public getters.

candidates.explanation: The globally reachable shared instance contains mutable state without a consistent isolation boundary. Although several mutation methods use MainActor, the class and its publicly readable mutable properties are not actor-isolated or synchronized; @Published does not provide that isolation.
candidates.title: Shared Mutable Instance State Without Isolation

evidence.description: The provider is an ordinary class rather than an actor or globally actor-isolated class.
The instance contains mutable, publicly readable authentication and profile state without a visible synchronization mechanism.
nonisolated(unsafe) explicitly opts the globally shared reference to this mutable instance out of concurrency-safety checking.

candidates.explanation: The unsafe annotation on shared exposes a mutable, non-actor-isolated class instance globally. The visible mutable properties have no consistent protection or safety invariant, so the opt-out is not justified merely by making the shared reference itself immutable.
candidates.title: Unjustified Unsafe Concurrency Escape Hatch
